findings.detail: Thirty-seven positions sourced from the December 31, 2025 comparative Schedule of Investments were retained in the March 31, 2026 holdings population.

rationale: The filing explicitly identifies a separate Consolidated Schedule of Investments as of December 31, 2025 (table 7 row 12). The flagged Al Altius position is present in that comparative schedule block at table 45 rows 20-21, while the March 31, 2026 schedule separately presents the issuer at table 17 rows 18-20 with different cost values. Retaining the earlier-period fact in the report-date holdings population is therefore a grounded comparative-period leakage error. The expected count of comparative rows in the report-date population is zero.
